description: Most January gatherings have no count. No threshold evidence was found for the two women's vigils, the Jan12 RC vigil, Jan20 Khartoum-state protests, several late-month demonstrations, El Gedaref sit-in or the El Geneina sit-in.
required_followup: Seek contemporaneous source bodies or local records that report assembled people by site and date; never transfer a campaign/week estimate to an individual action.

description: Kadugli article says Monday in a Jan7 report while its image caption says Jan4, 2020; the event is provisionally dated Jan4, 2021 based on the weekday/body, but the discrepancy remains.
required_followup: Check any original photo caption/context and a second contemporaneous account before resolving the date.

description: Kadugli reporting describes insecurity and rising crime but the exact demand to the Sudanese state is not clear.
required_followup: Review complete article and independent local reporting for explicit state-directed demand wording.

description: The Jan11 women's vigils occurred in two cities on the same day; the relationship and count per site are unresolved.
required_followup: Find organizer/source details that establish whether this was one coordinated action or two local events and locate each attendance.

description: Ed Damazin student protest reporting says El Roseires students joined, but does not clarify whether this was a second site or the same event unit.
required_followup: Seek location-specific reporting and counts for Ed Damazin and El Roseires; retain separate candidates if local actions were distinct.

description: Ed Damazin reporting attributes tear gas and rubber bullets to security forces on Jan18 but does not report clear gunfire or physical end; no other response dimensions are established.
required_followup: Find event-specific sources on method, shots, arrests, injuries and whether the crowd physically dispersed.

description: The North Kordofan bakery strike has no participant count and may be a work stoppage rather than a public gathering; no direct state target is documented.
required_followup: Open any linked original reports or union statements for gathering form, headcount, first/last day and demand recipient.

description: Atbara Industrial School students protested breakfast-meal pricing, but the source does not identify who set the price or whether the state was asked to act.
required_followup: Find a contemporary account identifying school status, price decision maker, explicit demand and attendance.

description: Friday Jan22 neighborhood protests, Saturday Jan23 multi-site demonstrations and Sunday Jan24 demonstrations may include recurring/local escalations, but the reporting does not settle overlaps or national coordination.
required_followup: Compare dates, organizers and sites across original accounts; do not sum estimates or merge daily street protests automatically.

description: No site-level attendance is known for the Jan23 broader Khartoum/Bahri/Omdurman actions; Anadolu's 'hundreds' is aggregate and Al Araby gives no count.
required_followup: Seek a source that ties a count to a specific event/site or resolves an accepted aggregate event boundary.

description: Jan24 reporting includes tear gas at Street60, while a later article vaguely refers to 'police suppression' in many neighborhoods; only the site-specific gas report is coded as dispersal.
required_followup: Find dated/site-specific details for any additional dispersal, arrests, beatings, deaths or shootings.

description: Jebel Awliya protesters were reportedly whipped by Central Reserve Police, but the report does not date the crowd; month ownership is unconfirmed.
required_followup: Locate the original date/location account and crowd details before assigning the episode to January.

description: The New Arab mention of protests against normalization with Israel lacks event date, location and turnout.
required_followup: Find the specific contemporary report; do not treat an undated policy protest lead as a January event without direct evidence.

description: Direct Dabanga links S005 and S038 and Al Rakoba S054 returned actual HTTP403 and were not retried. Masrawy/Al Rakoba pages S012, S014, S015 and S019 returned a non-retryable web-tool error with no HTTP status/body, not a publisher denial. Darfur24 Arabic S052 returned HTTP200 but only title/date were extracted; Anadolu S057 timed out. These records remain blocked or search-only as appropriate.
required_followup: Respect actual denials. Do not retry exact blocked URLs; only consider a single ordinary public request for a web-tool error where no site denial occurred and policy permits.

description: Some relevant items remain search-only, including several Arabic search leads, an Anadolu delegation article and a broad Dabanga labor result; header/preview alone cannot establish occurrence or response.
required_followup: Prioritize source body access only where a specific candidate field could change; preserve search_only for any unopened item.

description: Arabic reports were read with working translation; no independent human translation review was available. This affects event dates, demands and state-response phrasing.
required_followup: Obtain independent Arabic review before any final coding or interpretation of ambiguous phrases.

description: Multiple reports are from Dabanga. Al Rakoba S056 explicitly credits/reprints Dabanga and is not independent corroboration; same-outlet retrospectives and follow-ups are also dependent. AFP credit on Al Araby S016 is for the photo only; it does not establish written-story syndication.
required_followup: Verify outlet/byline/source attribution for any added report and separate independent reporting from reprints, timelines and file-photo credits.

description: El Geneina January reports establish a sit-in was active during January but conflict on its precise first day (Jan24 vs Jan25 by day-count implication). The stationary sit-in has no attendance figure; a separate march report describes thousands but does not date itself exactly.
required_followup: Resolve January-only onset/participant and march-versus-sit-in boundaries. Do not use February agreement/lifting reports to infer January onset or attendance.

description: February El Geneina reports describe an agreement to end, preparations to lift and a later reported lift, but do not document physical departure or resolve January onset/attendance; they are kept separate from January event coding.
required_followup: For cross-month episode review, seek direct physical-boundary evidence and keep the February campaign follow-up distinct unless its link to the January gathering is independently established.

description: Open-web search is not equivalent to LexisNexis; explicit date windows returned many old/out-of-month results, and no result total is exposed beyond captured headers. Search coverage does not prove absence or exhaustiveness.
required_followup: Use equivalent archival collections and additional local/regional and rights-monitoring sources when available; do not infer zero events from search returns.

description: Official latest Dataverse bytes/universe/schema/additional Coding Procedure remain unverified; the unit uses the coordinator-supplied provisional code and the historical May2015 manual. This is a global compatibility gate.
required_followup: Coordinator must resolve baseline and protocol compatibility before any official IDs, merge or contribution.
